_note: Template vars {{event_id}}, {{event_name}}, {{booth}} are supplied as positional args to agent.py
name: TCG Agent {{event_name}}
index_description:
Pokémon trading cards in the {{event_name}} vending machine — 1 record = 1 card. Use for inventory, availability, and pricing questions.

Key attributes:
- pokemon_name (searchable): the Pokémon on the card
- number (searchable): card number within its set
- card_type (searchable, filterable): rarity/type such as Gold, Illustration Rare, Special Illustration Rare
- set_name (searchable, filterable): the card set
- pokemon_types (searchable, filterable, multi-valued): e.g. Fire, Water
- estimated_value (filterable, numeric): estimated market value in USD
- machine_quantity (filterable, numeric): quantity currently in the machine
- initial_quantity (numeric): quantity originally loaded
- is_chase_card, is_top_10_chase_card, is_classic_pokemon, is_full_art (filterable booleans)
- image_small, image_large: card image URLs
- set_id: set identifier

estimated_value and machine_quantity support numeric range filtering (e.g. estimated_value > 50); pokemon_types is multi-valued.

replicas.description: Same {{event_name}} card inventory as the primary index, pre-sorted by estimated_value ascending (least valuable first). Use when the user wants the cheapest or lowest-value cards.
Same {{event_name}} card inventory as the primary index, pre-sorted by estimated_value descending (most valuable first). Use when the user wants the most valuable or highest-priced cards.
